candidates.title: Anthropic 发布八个月威胁情报报告：AI 从助手走向网络攻击编排者

evidence.claim: Anthropic 于 2026-09-10 发布报告，覆盖 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 8 月七类滥用，并称已中断相关活动、加强防护和共享情报。
evidence.excerpt: Over the past eight months... covers activity we disrupted between December 2025 and August 2026 across seven harm areas.

evidence.claim: 报告称多数网络行动由多智能体框架支持侦察、利用和数据外传，人类仍设定目标并复核外传。
evidence.excerpt: A majority of the operations described... involved multi-agent frameworks executing reconnaissance, exploitation, and data exfiltration; humans remained in the loop.

evidence.claim: GTG-20006 被 Anthropic 归因为与公开报道的 Midnight Blizzard、俄罗斯国家关联活动一致，并针对乌克兰、欧洲政府与无人机供应链。
evidence.excerpt: Our attribution is consistent with public reporting linking the actor to Midnight Blizzard... targeting are consistent with Russian state-nexus espionage.

evidence.excerpt: AI agents performed nearly all of the work... In every instance, the API keys involved were stolen from Anthropic customers’ environments.
